sloka: क्षयं नीता महाराज सपर्वतसरिद्द्रुमा ।एते चान्ये च बहवो बलवन्तो दुरासदाः ।। ७.२२.२८ ॥
transliteration: kṣayaṁ nītā mahārāja saparvatasariddrumā ।ete cānye ca bahavo balavanto durāsadāḥ ।। 7.22.28 ॥

translations.english: Sages, serpents, Daityas, Yakshas, and groups of Apsaras, along with the earth and its great oceans at the end of an age, were all present.
